assertions.evidence: Contract command: `cd apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/services/rsv-tick-service.test.ts src/lib/reservations-email.test.ts src/lib/reservations-sms.test.ts` -> exit 0, Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 155 passed (155). Message-delivery files (substituted for the contract's '<message-delivery test file>'): `cd apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/services/rsv-message-service.test.ts src/services/rsv-message-queue.test.ts` -> exit 0, 55 + 46 tests passed. Backoff: test 'backs off 1, 5 and 30 minutes, then ends failed after the fourth attempt' asserts RETRY_BACKOFF_MIN=[1,5,30], attempts 1/2/3, next_attempt_at = now + 1/5/30 min, not due before its time, then {status:'failed', attempts:4, lastErrorCode:'send_failed'} and a final row that never sends again. Error code: 'stores only an error code, never provider text or the destination' (lastErrorCode='send_failed'; the row dump contains neither 'hunter2' nor the guest email). Retry success: 'succeeds on a retry and records the attempt'. Dedupe: rsv_messages.dedupe_key has a unique constraint and enqueue uses onConflictDoNothing (rsv-message-queue.ts:80,103); tests 'is idempotent per schedule version and starts a new key when the version moves' (second enqueue returns []), 'treats each variant as a separate deliberate send' (repeat returns []) and 'never touches a row that was already sent'. Tick-side delivery: 'deliver_messages > sends a due message and counts it', 'leaves a message that is not due yet', 'retries a failed send after a minute and says when'. Transport failures on the dev surface are asserted by these tests, as the contract allows. Evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/t1-suites/VAL-MSG-022-delivery-backoff.txt

assertions.limitations: The running-system half ('the reservations tick also fires by itself via the Node interval: with no manual tick, a due reminder is delivered within roughly two interval periods') could not be observed: at 2026-10-17 11:12 UTC the live acme tenant DB had 0 pending messages due (earliest pending reminder send_at 2026-10-18 23:00 UTC, 29 pending reminders all in the future), so no due reminder existed to be delivered within two 120 s periods. The interval itself is proven by the passing unit tests (default 120 s, min 60, 0 off) and by the code path (startReservationsTickInterval, no RESERVATIONS_TICK_INTERVAL_SECONDS override on the running node); per the parent's instruction I did not wait indefinitely.

assertions.evidence: Delivery re-check tests: `cd apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/services/rsv-message-service.test.ts src/services/rsv-tick-service.test.ts` -> exit 0, 55 + 71 passed; describe 'send-time eligibility' includes 'cancels a reminder for a booking that was cancelled, with no send' (status cancelled, lastErrorCode not_eligible, no send), 'cancels a reminder for a booking whose start has passed', 'cancels a stale reminder after the schedule version moved on' (stale_schedule; the fresh row still sends), 'sends a reminder for a confirmed booking but cancels a reconfirmation for it' (the guest-already-confirmed case), 'suppresses a late confirmation or modification for a dead booking but still sends the cancellation notices' (status suppressed, not_eligible), 'suppresses a message for an erased guest, with only a code stored'. Live sqlite (`sqlite3 .../tenant_t58bgatqh3rv0s3movrecyj1.db`, SELECT only, now 2026-10-17 11:11 UTC): message statuses cancelled 1 / pending 29 / sent 19; the single non-pending scheduled row is reminder a7780f4a-edc6-47b3-868e-79a467e0b816 for reservation rsv_3bb0023e-9ce6-46f8-bb43-cb60720fcdbd (status cancelled, start 2026-10-28 22:30 UTC), i.e. a message that left the eligible status before its send_at and was never delivered. Capture absence: `grep -rl a7780f4a apps/tenant-api/.dev-mail/` -> no capture file references it; capture meta.messageKind counts are cancellation_restaurant 1, confirmation 12, notify_available 1, waitlist_joined 3, waitlist_ready 2 — no reminder capture exists. Evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/t1-suites/VAL-MSG-028-suppressed-tests-and-live.txt, VAL-MSG-028-suppressed-live-sqlite.txt, VAL-MSG-028-capture-absence.txt
assertions.notes: Vocabulary note for synthesis: for scheduled rows the terminal status is 'cancelled' with last_error_code 'not_eligible' (stale reminder/reconfirm), and 'suppressed' is used for confirmation/modification of a dead booking and for erased guests; the contract phrase 'marked suppressed' does not literally match the reminder/reconfirm path. The behavior the assertion protects — a message that left the eligible status before send_at is stopped at the tick/write path and never appears in the capture — is implemented and proven by the tests and the live row. No row in the live DB currently has status='suppressed' (the suppression population of VAL-MSG-013/014 is not preserved in the live DB).
assertions.limitations: The live half could not freshly observe a tick-time suppression because no stale pending row existed during this session; it observed the surviving stale row's outcome (never sent, absent from the capture) instead.
